0: The container does not set potentially sensitive environment variables
The container sets potentially sensitive environment variables

'$schema': http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema
type: object
properties:
  env:
    type: array
    items:
      type: object
      anyOf:
        - not:
            required: ["value"]
        - required: ["name", "value"]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
              '$comment': These environment variable names will be disallowed.
              allOf:
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^AZURE_.+KEY$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)^OCI_CLI_KEY_CONTENT$'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)password'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)token'
                - not:
                    pattern: '(?i)bearer'
                - not:
                    pattern: '^(?!STAKATER).*(?i)secret'
                  '$comment': This allows variable names not excluded above.
                - pattern: '(?i).*'
            value:
              type: string
              '$comment': These environment variable values will be disallowed.
              allOf:
              - not:
                  '$comment': This matches variations like begin private key, begin rsa private key ...
                  pattern: '(?i)\s*-BEGIN\s+.PRIVATE KEY-\s'
        - required: ["name", "valueFrom"]
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
            valueFrom:
              type: object
The ConfigMap does not contain potentially sensitive content in its keys and values
Potentially sensitive content is detected in the ConfigMap keys or values

'$schema': http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema
type: object
required: ["metadata"]
properties:
  metadata:
    required: ["name"]
    properties:
      name:
        type: string
  data:
    type: object
    propertyNames:
      '$comment': These ConfigMap keys will be disallowed.
      allOf:
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^AZURE_.+KEY$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)^OCI_CLI_KEY_CONTENT$'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)password'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)token'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)bearer'
        - not:
            pattern: '(?i)secret(?!.*namespace)'
          '$comment': This allows ConfigMap keys not excluded above.
        - pattern: '(?i).*'
    additionalProperties:
      '$comment': These ConfigMap values will be disallowed.
      allOf:
      - not:
          '$comment': THis matches variations like begin private key, begin rsa private key ...
          pattern: '(?i)\s*-BEGIN\s+.*PRIVATE KEY-\s*'

apk add --no-cache openssl >/dev/null
mkdir -p /data/tls
if [ ! -f /data/tls/privkey.pem ]; then
  openssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout /data/tls/privkey.pem \
    -out /data/tls/fullchain.pem \
    -subj "/CN=mail.sa7mie.se"
  echo "Created bootstrap self-signed TLS cert in /data/tls"
fi

setup:
  codecov_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}
  codecov_api_url: https://{{.Values.codecov.host }}

  debug: no
  loglvl: INFO

  guest_access: off
  admins:
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Saphir
    - service: gitlab_enterprise
      username: Alexsaphir

  http:
    cookies_domain: {{.Values.codecov.host }}

  timeseries:
    enabled: false
  ta_timeseries:
    enabled: false

  telemetry:
    enabled: false

gitlab_enterprise:
  enabled: true
  url: https://gitlab.${DOMAIN_NAME}
  global_upload_token_enabled: false

  bot:
